requirements.quote:
A BGP speaker may transmit routes with overlapping Network Layer
   Reachability Information (NLRI) to another BGP speaker.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker transmits routes to another BGP speaker.
requirements.required_behavior: The speaker may transmit routes with overlapping NLRI.
requirements.why_checkable: Route export can be checked for permitted overlapping prefixes.

requirements.quote:
Because BGP encodes NLRI using IP prefixes, overlap
   will always exhibit subset relationships.
requirements.condition: Encoding BGP Network Layer Reachability Information.
requirements.why_checkable: The NLRI representation can be inspected for IP prefix encoding.

requirements.quote:
The set of destinations described by the overlap represents a portion
   of the less specific route that is feasible, but is not currently in
   use.
requirements.condition: A more specific route and a feasible less specific route overlap.
requirements.required_behavior: Use the more specific route for the overlapping destinations; the overlapping portion of the less specific route remains feasible but is not currently in use.
requirements.why_checkable: Lookup of an overlapping destination can reveal which route takes precedence.

requirements.quote:
If a more specific route is later withdrawn, the set of
   destinations described by the overlap will still be reachable using
   the less specific route.
requirements.condition: A more specific route is withdrawn while a feasible less specific route covers its destinations.
requirements.required_behavior: Keep the overlapping destinations reachable using the less specific route.
requirements.why_checkable: Withdrawal followed by route lookup can check fallback to the covering route.

requirements.quote:
If a BGP speaker receives overlapping routes, the Decision Process
   MUST consider both routes based on the configured acceptance policy.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker receives overlapping routes.
requirements.required_behavior: The Decision Process MUST consider both routes based on the configured acceptance policy.
requirements.why_checkable: Route selection can be inspected for independent policy evaluation of both overlapping routes.

requirements.quote:
If both a less and a more specific route are accepted, then the
   Decision Process MUST install, in Loc-RIB, either both the less and



Rekhter, et al.             Standards Track                    [Page 83]

RFC 4271                         BGP-4                      January 2006


   the more specific routes or aggregate the two routes and install, in
   Loc-RIB, the aggregated route, provided that both routes have the
   same value of the NEXT_HOP attribute.
requirements.condition: Both a less specific route and a more specific route are accepted.
requirements.required_behavior: The Decision Process MUST install both routes in Loc-RIB, or aggregate the two and install the aggregated route in Loc-RIB provided that both routes have the same NEXT_HOP.
requirements.why_checkable: Accepted overlapping routes can be compared with the resulting Loc-RIB entries and NEXT_HOP values.

requirements.quote:
If both a less and a more specific route are accepted, then the
   Decision Process MUST install, in Loc-RIB, either both the less and



Rekhter, et al.             Standards Track                    [Page 83]

RFC 4271                         BGP-4                      January 2006


   the more specific routes or aggregate the two routes and install, in
   Loc-RIB, the aggregated route, provided that both routes have the
   same value of the NEXT_HOP attribute.
requirements.condition: The Decision Process aggregates accepted overlapping less and more specific routes instead of installing both in Loc-RIB.
requirements.required_behavior: Both routes must have the same NEXT_HOP attribute value for this aggregation alternative.
requirements.why_checkable: Aggregation eligibility can be checked with equal and unequal NEXT_HOP values.

requirements.quote:
If a BGP speaker chooses to aggregate, then it SHOULD either include
   all ASes used to form the aggregate in an AS_SET, or add the
   ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute to the route.
requirements.condition: A BGP speaker chooses to aggregate routes.
requirements.required_behavior: The speaker SHOULD either include all ASes used to form the aggregate in an AS_SET or add ATOMIC_AGGREGATE to the route.
requirements.why_checkable: The resulting aggregate can be checked for complete AS_SET membership or ATOMIC_AGGREGATE.
Route transformations can be inspected for de-aggregation.

requirements.quote:
In particular, a route that carries the
   ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute MUST NOT be de-aggregated.  That is, the
   NLRI of this route cannot be more specific.
requirements.condition: A route carries the ATOMIC_AGGREGATE attribute.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: The route MUST NOT be de-aggregated: its NLRI cannot be made more specific.
requirements.why_checkable: Route export and transformation can be checked for more specific NLRI derived from a route bearing ATOMIC_AGGREGATE.
